_provenance.a3_revision_2026_08_04: The block netlist was NOT layout-realizable and therefore could never close A6 (per-block LVS): it carried an ideal in-block voltage source (Vbias), ideal 100k resistors and ideal 3p/20p capacitors, none of which has an extractable PDK counterpart, so netgen could never match layout to schematic. Revision (topology, device geometry and divider ratio UNCHANGED): (1) Vbias -> block port VBIAS driven by the testbench; (2) R1/R2 -> sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po_1p41 L=440.9um (99.9998k each; W=1.41 because the 0p69 gencell violates sky130 rpm.1); (3) Cc -> 2 x sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 27.5x27.5um (3.066 pF); (4) Cl (the LOAD cap, per topology.md) moved to tb_ldo.sp beside Iload. A4 was RE-RUN on the revised deck: Vout 1.20222-1.21456 V and |PSRR@100Hz| 47.47-55.30 dB over the same 9 PVT corners - unchanged to 5 significant figures.
